```yaml
name: Security Scan

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  security-scan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Run security scan
      run: |
        # Add your security scan command here
        # For example, using golangci-lint
        go install github.com/golangci/golangci-lint/cmd/golangci-lint@latest
        golangci-lint run

    - name: Update commit status on failure
      if: ${{ failure() }}
      uses: mattermost/actions/delivery/update-commit-status@f324ac89b05cc3511cb06e60642ac2fb829f0a63
      with:
        repository_full_name: stacklok/toolhive
        commit_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
        context: "Security Scan"
        description: "Security scan failed"
        status: "failure"
        target_url: "https://github.com/stacklok/toolhive/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}"

    - name: Notify Slack on failure
      if: ${{ failure() }}
      uses: act10ns/slack@44541246747a30eb3102d87f7a4cc5471b0ffb7d
      with:
        webhook-url: ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}
        status: "failure"
        steps: ${{ toJson(steps) }}
        channel: "#security-alerts"
        message: "Security scan failed for ${github.repository}#${github.event_number}"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file will perform a security scan when changes are pushed to or a pull request is opened against the `main` branch. If the security scan fails, it will update the commit status to "failure" and notify a Slack channel about the failure.
